name: omo-webchat-win32-arm64
description: Prebuilt omo-webchat server binary for win32/arm64 (Go windows/arm64).

scripts.prepack: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const p='exe/omo-webchat-bin.exe';try{if(!fs.statSync(p).isFile())throw 0;fs.accessSync(p,fs.constants.X_OK)}catch{console.error('prepack: expected executable '+p+' is missing or not executable');process.exit(1)}"
